verdict.rationale: Xero has a comprehensive public API with SDKs, OpenAPI descriptions, and an official MCP server exposing contact/account/invoice management, suggesting broad API parity with core UI workflows. However, there is no explicit evidence confirming full feature parity for advanced/newer UI features (e.g., AI tools like JAX, multi-currency consolidation, reporting/KPI dashboards, bill payment automation) being accessible via API, and no independent audit confirming complete parity. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or third-party verification that all UI features (reporting, JAX AI tools, project tracking, benchmarking) are exposed via API/MCP, and confirmation there are no UI-only features.
